questions.stem:
The correct statement/s about Hydrogen bonding is/are :
A. Hydrogen bonding exists when H is covalently bonded to the highly electro negative atom.
B. Intermolecular H bonding is present in o-nitro phenol
C. Intramolecular H bonding is present in HF.
D. The magnitude of H bonding depends on the physical state of the compound.
E. H-bonding has powerful effect on the structure and properties of compounds.
Choose the correct answer from the options given below :
questions.solution:
(A) Generally hydrogen bonding exists when H is covalently bonded to the highly electronegative atom like F, O, N.
(B) Intramolecular H bonding is present in o-nitrophenol (structure shown).
(C) Intermolecular Hydrogen bonding is present in HF
(D) The magnitude has Hydrogen bonding in solid state is greater than liquid state.
(E) Hydrogen bonding has powerfull effect on the structure & properties of compound like melting point, boiling point, density etc.

questions.stem: Three moles of an ideal gas are compressed isothermally from 60 L to 20 L using constant pressure of 5 atm. Heat exchange Q for the compression is $-$ ____ Lit. atm.
questions.solution:
As isothermal $\Delta U = 0$
and process is irreversible
$Q = -W = -[-P_{ext}(V_2 - V_1)]$
$Q = 5(20 - 60) = -200$ atm-L

2.7 Kg of each of water and acetic acid are mixed, The freezing point of the solution will be $-x\ ^\circ\mathrm{C}$. Consider the acetic acid does not dimerise in water, nor dissociates in water $x$ = ______(nearest integer)
[Given : Molar mass of water = 18 g mol$^{-1}$, acetic acid = 60 g mol$^{-1}$
$K_f$ $\mathrm{H_2O}$ : 1.86 K kg mol$^{-1}$
$K_f$ acetic acid : 3.90 K kg mol$^{-1}$
freezing point : $\mathrm{H_2O}$ = 273 K, acetic acid = 290 K]
questions.solution:
As moles of water > moles of $\mathrm{CH_3COOH}$
water is solvent.
$T^{\circ}_F - (T_F)_S = K_F \times M$
$0 - (T_F)_S = 1.86 \times \frac{2700/60}{2700/1000}$
$(T_F)_S = -31^\circ\mathrm{C}$.

questions.stem: Vanillin compound obtained from vanilla beans, has total sum of oxygen atoms and $\pi$ electrons is__
questions.solution:
Vanillin compound is an organic compound molecular formula $\mathrm{C_8H_8O_3}$. It is a phenolic aldehyde. Its functional compounds include aldehyde, hydroxyl and ether. It is the primary component of the extract of the vanilla beans.
Total sum of oxygen atoms and $\pi$-electrons is $3 + 8 = 11$
Total number of oxygen atoms = 3
Total number of $\pi$-bonds = 4
$\therefore$ Total number of $\pi$-electrons = 8
